class.name: ros2_waveshare::SingleMotorModel
class.description:
Single motor velocity control using PID controller.
Implements closed-loop velocity control for a single motor by converting linear velocity commands (m/s) to angular motor velocity (rad/s) using wheel radius, then applying PID control based on encoder feedback.
Features: - PID control with tunable gains (kp, ki, kd) - Anti-windup for integral term - Acceleration limiting for smooth motion - Automatic unit conversion (linear ↔ angular)
Use Cases: - Testing single motor before integrating into multi-motor systems - Direct wheel control applications - Linear actuators with rotary motors
Parameters (namespace: single_motor_model): - kp: Proportional gain (default: 1.0) - ki: Integral gain (default: 0.1) - kd: Derivative gain (default: 0.05) - max_velocity: Maximum linear velocity in m/s (default: 1.0) - max_acceleration: Maximum acceleration in m/s² (default: 2.0) - max_integral: Anti-windup limit (default: 10.0) - wheel_radius: Wheel radius in meters (default: 0.1) - gear_ratio: Gear reduction ratio motor:wheel (default: 1.0)

class.name: ros2_waveshare::DifferentialDriveModel
class.description:
Differential drive kinematics for two-wheel robots.
Converts Twist commands (linear.x, angular.z) to left/right motor velocities using differential drive kinematics equations.
Features: - Forward and inverse kinematics - Wheel base and wheel radius configuration - Independent PID control for each wheel - Odometry-based feedback
Use Cases: - Two-wheeled differential drive robots - Mobile platforms with skid steering
Status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED

class.name: ros2_waveshare::AckermannModel
class.description:
Ackermann steering geometry for car-like robots.
Implements Ackermann steering kinematics with separate drive and steering motors. Converts Twist commands to steering angle and drive velocity considering vehicle geometry constraints.
Features: - Ackermann geometry calculations - Steering angle limits and rate limiting - Center of rotation path planning - Four-wheel vehicle dynamics
Use Cases: - Car-like robots with front-wheel steering - Autonomous vehicles - Agricultural/industrial vehicles
Status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED
